provenance.line: log_to_generic_json, and the assertions in test_convert_logs_generic_mode
provenance.note: OTLP tags _signal, not _source, and only in GENERIC mode. The HyperDx and OTel modes emit the ClickHouse otel column names -- Timestamp, Body, ServiceName, SeverityText, LogAttributes -- with no marker key at all, so the transport has two detectable shapes and one undetectable one.
